book.name: 2 Aj Corint
book.title: Tkabꞌ Tuꞌj Pabl kye Nimil aj Corint

content: Qo qꞌon oyaj tukꞌa tkyaqil qanmin
Atzin jaꞌlin, werman, qaja tuꞌn kybꞌintiꞌy tzeꞌn ma yekꞌine t-xtalbꞌil Dios tojjo Ttanim toj ttxꞌotxꞌ Macedonia.

Exla qa nimx sikyꞌx kyuꞌn wen toj kynimbꞌil, exla qa manyor yajqe erman anetziꞌn, me tzunx nchi tzalajx, ex tbꞌaꞌnilx chi oyin tukꞌa tkyaqil kyanmin, nyakuj manyor qꞌininqexnaj wen, tuꞌn kymojin kyukꞌa nimil toj Jerusalén.
Twutzxix nyola, quꞌn ma nliꞌy, qa xi kyqꞌoꞌn tukꞌa tkyaqil kyanmin tiꞌjjo chꞌin at kye, ex mape txi kyqꞌoꞌn chꞌintl tibꞌaj.
Ox chi kubꞌsinx kywutz qeꞌy, tuꞌn t-xi qtziyiꞌn tuꞌn kyok mojil qukꞌiꞌy tiꞌjjo onbꞌil kye erman toj Jerusalén.
Quꞌn nimxixtl bꞌant kyuꞌn, tzeꞌnkuljo qeꞌ kubꞌ qbꞌisin nej; xi kyqꞌoꞌn kyibꞌ tuꞌn kyajbꞌin te Dios, ex kyaqꞌ kyibꞌ tuꞌn kyajbꞌin qeꞌy, tzeꞌnku taj qMan.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, ma qo kubꞌsin qwutza te Tito, tuꞌn t-xiꞌ juntl majl kyukꞌiy, tuꞌntzintla tjapin kyuꞌn tuꞌn kywenila, tuꞌn tja chmetjo oyaj, a otaq txi xkye tuꞌn.

Quꞌn ikytziꞌn tzeꞌnkuxjo nchi chꞌiya wen toj tkyaqil: Tzeꞌnku toj kynimbꞌila, ex jniꞌ kyxnaqꞌtzbꞌila, ex at-xix kynabꞌla, ex o tzꞌok tilil kyuꞌn tuꞌn kyela wen toj nwutza, ex nim kykꞌuꞌja qiꞌja; ikyxsintzjo tojjo tbꞌanil onbꞌil lo, ok kchi elila twutz.
Mi xi nqꞌmanjiꞌy luꞌn kyeꞌy tzeꞌnku jun kawbꞌil, qalaꞌ noq waja tuꞌn tel nnikyꞌa te, qa tukꞌa tkyaqil kyanmiꞌn kxel kyqꞌonjiy onbꞌil lo, ikyxjo tzeꞌnku kye erman toj Macedonia.

Quꞌn bꞌiꞌn kyuꞌn a t-xtalbꞌil qAjaw Jesucrist: Attaq tkyaqil qꞌinimil tukꞌa toj kyaꞌj, me noq tuꞌn kypaja, bꞌeꞌx kyij ttzaqpiꞌn tkyaqil, exsin kubꞌ tqꞌoꞌn tibꞌtz tzaluꞌn twutz txꞌotxꞌ tzeꞌnku jun xjal yaj, tuꞌntzintla kyoka te qꞌinin tojjo kynimbꞌila tiꞌj, noq tuꞌn yajbꞌil n-ikyꞌxtaq tuꞌn.
Tiꞌj tkyaqiljo luꞌn kxel nqꞌoꞌn jun tumil: Tojjo abꞌqꞌe xbꞌaj, nya noq kubꞌ kybꞌisiꞌn tuꞌn t-xi kyqꞌoꞌn jun oyaj, qalaꞌ bꞌeꞌx tzyetku tchimle kyuꞌn.
Atzin jaꞌlin, kyqꞌonka tilil, tuꞌn tjapin bꞌaj kyuꞌn, tzeꞌnkuxjo at kyeꞌy, ex tzeꞌnkuxjo kybꞌisa, tej t-xi xkyeku kyuꞌn te tnejil.
Quꞌn qa ma txi kyqꞌoꞌn jun oyaj tzeꞌnkux at kyeꞌy tukꞌa tkyaqil kyanmiꞌn, ntzalaj te Dios tiꞌj, a xi kyqꞌoꞌn tzeꞌnkuxjo at kyeꞌy, quꞌn mi nqaninte Dios tiꞌjjo a ntiꞌ at kyeꞌy.
Mi nxi nqꞌmanjiꞌy luꞌn, tuꞌn t-xi kyqꞌoꞌn tkyaqiljo at kyeꞌy, ex tuꞌn tok yajil kyiꞌja, noq tuꞌn kypajjo txqantl; qalaꞌ tuꞌntzin junx tuꞌn kyeliꞌy.
Quꞌn qa at chꞌin kyeꞌy jaꞌlin, tuꞌn kymojiꞌn kyiꞌjjo txqantl; ex bꞌalaqa toj juntl majl ayetl kchi mojil kyiꞌja, aj tel bꞌajjo kye. Ikytzin tumiljo, tuꞌn qel junx,
ikyxjo tzeꞌnku ntqꞌmaꞌn toj Tuꞌjil Tyol Dios tiꞌjjo maná, a xi tqꞌoꞌn Dios kye aj Israel:

content.text: Ayeꞌ ilaꞌ kybꞌaj ex nim o chmet kyuꞌn,
Ex ayeꞌ nya ilaꞌ kybꞌaj, ex nya nim o chmet kyuꞌn,
exla qa noq kyinchaqjo teyile junjunch.

content: Tej t-xi tsmaꞌn Pabl Tito toj Corint
Chjonte qMan Dios, tuꞌn xkux tqꞌoꞌn toj tanmin Tito nim tkꞌuꞌj kyiꞌja tzeꞌnkuxjo weꞌ.
Quꞌn tej qkubꞌsin qwutza te, tuꞌn t-xiꞌ juntl majl kyukꞌiy, ox tzalajx wen, quꞌn tuꞌn otaqx kubꞌ tbꞌisin tuꞌn t-xiꞌ lol kyeꞌy.
Ex at juntl erman, ma txi qsmaꞌn tukꞌa Tito, bꞌaꞌnxix tyolajtz kyuꞌn tkyaqil Ttanim Dios, tuꞌn taqꞌnbꞌin tiꞌj Tbꞌanil Tqanil.
Ex nya oꞌkxjo, qalaꞌ aye Ttanim Dios ma chi jaw skꞌonte erman luꞌn, tuꞌn t-xiꞌ qukꞌiꞌy tojjo qbꞌeꞌy, ex tuꞌn tonin tiꞌjjo onbꞌil, a kxel qiꞌn te nimsbꞌil tbꞌi qAjaw, ex te jun yekꞌbꞌil tiꞌjjo qwenil.
Nkubꞌ qbꞌinchinjiꞌy lo, quꞌn qkyꞌeꞌy tuꞌn kyyolbꞌinxjal qiꞌja, qa ma kubꞌ qyupin chꞌin tiꞌjjo oyaj ktzajil kyqꞌoꞌn qeꞌy.
Quꞌn tok tilil quꞌn, tuꞌn qbꞌinchiꞌn tkyaqil tojxix tumil twutz Dios ex kywutzxjal.
Ex junx kyukꞌa Tito, ma txi qsmaꞌn juntl qerman, ex o tzꞌok qkaꞌyiꞌn qa saqxix toj tkyaqil taqꞌin Dios. Ex tajxix tuꞌn tmojin tojjo lo, majxpe a jaꞌlin qꞌuqlekxix tkꞌuꞌj kyiꞌja.
Atzin kyiꞌjjo erman ayeꞌ, ntiꞌ jun chꞌotjbꞌil kyiꞌj. Quꞌn te Tito jun wukꞌa wejiꞌy toj aqꞌuntl kyxola, ex ayetzin txqantl, aye Ttanim Dios i xi smaꞌnte kyxola te kyxel, ex ntzalaj Crist kyiꞌj.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, kyyekꞌinxa qa at-xix kykꞌuꞌja kyiꞌj, ex japinxitjo qyola ma txi qqꞌmaꞌn kye, qa wenqexixa, tuꞌn kyoka te jun yekꞌbꞌil kywutzjo tkyaqil Ttanim Dios.
